newsitem.title: EU: Official Journal contents - OJ C 210 of July 11, 1997.
newsitem.headline: Official Journal contents - OJ C 210 of July 11, 1997.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)

Notice of initiation of an anti-dumping proceeding concerning imports of unbleached cotton fabrics originating in the People's Republic of China, Egypt, India, Indonesia, Pakistan and Turkey (97/C 210/09)

Information Programme for European Citizens - Call for proposals AP/97-01/TF Support for communication schemes to further the European Community's priority information campaign 'Building Europe Together' (97/C 210/08)
ASSENT No 5/97 given by the Council pursuant to Article 95 of the Treaty establishing the European Coal and Steel Community (97/C 210/07)
ASSENT No 4/97 given by the Council pursuant to Article 95 of the Treaty establishing the European Coal and Steel Community (97/C 210/06)
Commission Communication concerning the basic prices for certain iron and steel products (97/C 210/05)
Prior notification of a notified concentration (Case No IV/M.918 - Klockner/ODS) (97/C 210/04)
COUNCIL DECISION of 27 June 1997 appointing the members of the Advisory Committee of the Euratom Supply Agency (97/C 210/02)
COUNCIL RESOLUTION of 27 June 1997 on renewable sources of energy (97/C 210/01) END OF DOCUMENT.
